Title: Register a module with JsonJacksonCodec within YAML configuration
Description: Hello!

Regular user of Redisson here. I wanted to use the external configuration from YAML. I always initialized my `Config` from code.

Everything is working perfectly! But I wondered if there was any documentation on the `codec` field?

I am using the `JsonJacksonCodec` with the following config entry:
```YAML
codec: !!org.redisson.codec.JsonJacksonCodec {}
```

I want to register custom modules, such as the `JavaTImeModule` (`com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.jsr310.JavaTimeModule`). I inspected the source code and saw that this field is maybe using some really deep Jackson features to construct a class from a configuration.

Is any configuration sample or example provided? Or is there any Jackson article who explains this feature?

I am using the latest Redisson version.

After getting an answer, I'll make sure to PR some documentation additions in order to cover this case correctly :)

Thanks a lot!
Adam.
